title: Add 'account use <NAME>' Positional Shorthand
description: Add 'zapi account use <NAME>' as a convenient positional shorthand for setting the default account. This is more ergonomic than 'zapi account set-default --name <NAME>'. The existing 'account set-default' command is unchanged (no deprecation). Both forms coexist. This matches patterns from gh (gh config set) and similar CLIs where common operations have short forms.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1–27 complete. The only way to set the default account is 'zapi account set-default --name <NAME>' (or --email / --zuidstring). No positional shorthand exists.
goal: After this story: 'zapi account use myaccount' sets 'myaccount' as the default account and prints the same output as 'account set-default'. 'zapi account set-default --name myaccount' continues to work unchanged.
scope: Create a new command class 'AccountUseCommand' in src/ZapiCli/Commands/AccountCommands.cs. Its Settings class 'AccountUseSettings' has a single positional argument: [CommandArgument(0, "<NAME>")] public string Name { get; set; }. It also accepts --name <NAME> as a flag alternative (for parity/scripting). Exactly one of the positional argument or --name flag must be provided.

AccountUseCommand.ExecuteAsync: resolve the account by name, call the same set-default logic as AccountSetDefaultCommand. Output: { "status": "ok", "data": { "name": "<name>" } }. Error codes: ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, AMBIGUOUS_ACCOUNT.
In src/ZapiCli/Program.cs, inside the 'account' branch: add account.AddCommand<AccountUseCommand>("use").
Do NOT modify AccountSetDefaultCommand or its Settings — both commands coexist.
Do NOT emit a deprecation warning for AccountSetDefaultCommand — it is not deprecated.
acceptanceCriteria: 'zapi account use myaccount' sets myaccount as the active default and outputs { status: ok, data: { name: 'myaccount' } }
'zapi account use --name myaccount' also works (flag form)
'zapi account set-default --name myaccount' still works unchanged
ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND error is returned when the name does not match any stored account
'zapi account --help' output lists 'use' as a sub-command
contextForAgent: Read AccountSetDefaultCommand and its Settings to understand the switch logic and output format — AccountUseCommand should produce identical output and use the same IAccountStore method. The positional argument syntax in Spectre.Console.Cli is [CommandArgument(0, "<NAME>")] for required positionals. Verify whether Settings can have both a positional argument and a --name flag with mutual exclusivity — if not, just use the positional argument only.
openItems: Confirm whether Spectre.Console.Cli supports both a positional argument AND a named flag for the same logical value in the same Settings class.
